units.source_text: 左大臣也公私两方都不得意，心中不快，便上表致仕。

en.t: The Minister of the Left, dissatisfied in both public and private affairs, felt troubled at heart and submitted a petition to retire.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝想起桐壶院在世时一向信任这位大臣，视为重要的后援人，并有遗嘱，希望他长为天下之柱石。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku remembered that, while the Kiritsubo Retired Emperor was alive, he had always trusted this minister, regarded him as an important supporter, and left instructions hoping that he would long remain a pillar of the realm.
For that reason, he would not permit him to resign.
Again and again he submitted petitions, and again and again they were returned.

units.source_text: 但左大臣意志坚决，终于致仕还家。

en.t: But the Minister of the Left was firm in his resolve, and at last he retired from office and returned home.

units.source_text: 从此右大臣一族垄断朝政，荣华无可限量。

en.t: From then on, the family of the Minister of the Right monopolized the affairs of court, and their prosperity knew no bounds.

units.source_text: 一代重臣，今已遁世，朱雀帝不胜怅惘，世间知情达理之人，亦无不叹惋。

en.t: That great minister of his age had now withdrawn from the world, and Emperor Suzaku was filled with sorrow; all sensible and discerning people in society lamented it as well.
